column1: # The libraries Ratchet & Clank: Going Commando (NTSC-U) calls, by entry point, and what the port
# does with each: the same columns and port values as port/game/rac1-pal/libraries.tsv.
# A host row binds an entry point to the replacement of that name every game shares
# (port/game/common/libraries.tsv), or, with a signature of its own, to this game's host C
# (port/game/rac2-ntsc/host). Names come from the decompilation's symbol_addrs/usa/symbol_addrs.txt
# where it has them; the kernel's system-call wrappers are identified by the call number each
# loads into $v1 (ps2tek's EE kernel table). Entry points not here run from their C, or from
